Internet Technology and Risk Services (ITRS) is one of the sub Groups within GSD. Risk Systems as a part of ITRS builds and supports Technology Solutions which assist in detection, reduction and prevention of MasterCard credit and debit fraud. Risk products can be classified into 3 groups: 1. Pre-Fraud Detection 2. Event-Fraud Detection 3. Post-Fraud Detection. Pre-Fraud Detection products provide an opportunity to detect the potential fraudulent transaction before it occurs. Pre-Fraud detection is very important as it would prevent the fraud from occurring and thereby would limit issuer costs. Fraud Event: Detection products provide an opportunity to detect the potential fraudulent transaction at point of sale or shortly thereafter. Migration of database from oracle 10g to oracle 11g. Moving tables from current schemas to new schemas. Deploying and testing the web application for new schemas changes. Fixing bugs during the System testing and production deployment. Supporting for Customer testing of the application in MTF Environment before deploying into the production. Environment: Oracle 10g SVN, RAD 7.0, TOAD 8.6.1, Pega PRPC BPM Tool, Java, spring, Hibernate, Windows XP
